display.purpose: Screen titles, hero balances, invoice totals — the number the user came to check.

label.purpose: Tiny uppercase eyebrows above every stat value (Loud Label, Quiet Value Rule).

shadows.name: brutalist-primary
shadows.purpose: Yellow-theme main cards — the signature stuck-on-the-page look.

shadows.name: none-midnight
shadows.purpose: Midnight theme never shades — depth comes from the surface tonal step, not a shadow.

motion.name: sheet-spring
motion.purpose: Bottom-sheet slide-up for every modal (invoice summary, delivery tracking, promos).

motion.name: tap-compress
motion.purpose: Button tactile feedback — compression, not hover-lift.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.value: max-w-md (app shell is phone-width even on WEB)

components.name: Primary Button (Midnight)
components.description: Main CTA in dark theme — solid volt-green fill, black uppercase text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-mid { background: #00ff9d; color: #000000; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 1rem; font-size: 13px; transition: transform 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary-mid:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary-mid:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary-mid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00ff9d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button (Yellow)
components.description: Main CTA in brutalist light theme — solid black fill, yellow text, offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-yellow { background: #000000; color: #FFD700; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 12px 24px; border: 3px solid #000000; border-radius: 1rem; font-size: 13px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px rgba(0,0,0,1); transition: transform 0.15s ease-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary-yellow:active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px 0px rgba(0,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary-yellow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card (Midnight)
components.description: Standard surface container in dark theme — tonal border only, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card-mid { background: #201f1f; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 1.5rem; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-mid-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #b9cbbc; } .ds-card-mid-value { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 24px; color: #00ff9d; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Card (Yellow)
components.description: Standard surface container in brutalist light theme — thick black border, hard offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-card-yellow { background: #FFFFFF; border: 4px solid #000000; border-radius: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px 0px rgba(0,0,0,1); padding: 20px; color: #000000; } .ds-card-yellow-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #000000; } .ds-card-yellow-value { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 24px; color: #000000; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Bottom Sheet Handle
components.description: Drag-handle bar at the top of every bottom-sheet modal (invoice summary, tracking, promos).
components.css: .ds-sheet { background: #201f1f; border-radius: 1.5rem 1.5rem 0 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding: 20px; } .ds-sheet-handle { width: 40px; height: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 999px; margin: 0 auto 16px; } .ds-sheet-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Bottom Nav Pill
components.description: Floating rounded navigation bar shared by both themes; only the active-state fill swaps per theme.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); } .ds-nav-item { padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: transparent; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #6b7280; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #f3f4f6; color: #000000; }

narrative.overview: VOLT is one banking product with two physical materials depending on the hour. By day (Yellow theme) it's concrete: saturated yellow ground, thick black borders, hard offset shadows with zero blur — like a brutalist notebook margin, confident to the point of irreverence. By night (Midnight theme) it's neon: near-black surfaces, a single electric-green wire (volt-green #00ff9d) running through numbers and CTAs, glowing rather than shadowing. Neither skin is a "dark mode toggle" on the other; each has its own elevation physics, its own contrast rules, its own restraint. This system explicitly rejects generic fintech AI-slop — purple-blue gradients, gradient-clipped text, identical floating hero-metric cards — and rejects old-school corporate banking's navy-serious, bureaucratic density.
keyCharacteristics: Two fully-specified themes, never a single design reskinned after the fact
Zero soft shadows in either theme — hard offset (Yellow) or none (Midnight)
One accent per theme used with restraint
Brazilian fintech vocabulary is native, not translated

rules.name: The One Wire Rule
rules.body: Midnight has exactly one accent color in play at a time: volt-green.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Exception Rule
rules.body: Volt Yellow is the only brand color allowed to be a full-page background rather than an accent.

rules.name: The Loud Label, Quiet Value Rule
rules.body: Micro-labels are tiny, bold, and uppercase; the value beneath them is large.

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: Zero blur() in any shadow, in either theme.

dos: Do build every new component theme-aware from the start
Do use volt-green as the single accent wire in Midnight
Do keep micro-labels tiny/bold/uppercase and their values large
Do use the spring bottom-sheet pattern for any new modal
Do treat pt-BR formatting and Brazilian fintech vocabulary as first-class
donts: Don't use any blur-based box-shadow in either theme
Don't use purple-blue gradients, gradient-clipped text, or the SaaS hero-metric template
Don't default to navy-serious, bureaucratic, form-dense corporate-bank styling
Don't render a Yellow-theme card without its 3-4px black border
Don't introduce a second bright accent color competing with volt-green in Midnight screens
